title: Investments in Debt and Equity Securities - ASC 320
learning_objectives: Classify debt securities: HTM, AFS, Trading
Apply equity method for significant influence
Understand fair value vs. amortized cost

cpa_exam_relevance.blueprint_section: Area II - Select Financial Statement Accounts

three_classifications.criteria: Positive intent and ability to hold to maturity
three_classifications.requirements: ONLY for debt securities with fixed maturity

journal_entries_example.scenario: Purchase $100,000 bonds at $98,000 (discount). Classified as AFS. Year-end FV $101,000.
journal_entries_example.year_end_interest:
DR AFS Securities $XXX
   CR Interest Income $XXX
(Amortize discount using effective interest)
journal_entries_example.year_end_fv_adjustment:
DR AFS Securities $3,000
   CR Unrealized Gain-OCI $3,000
(Adjust to FV: $101,000 - $98,000)
journal_entries_example.when_sold: Reclassify accumulated OCI to income as realized gain/loss

classification_by_ownership.measurement: Fair value with changes in net income

equity_method_details.record_income:
DR Investment $XXX
   CR Equity in Investee Income $XXX
(% of investee's net income)
equity_method_details.record_dividend:
DR Cash $XXX
   CR Investment $XXX
(Reduces investment balance)
equity_method_details.key_concept: Investor's income statement includes share of investee's income regardless of dividends. Dividends reduce investment balance (return of capital concept).

equity_securities.fair_value_option: Entity may irrevocably elect FV measurement for equity investments without readily determinable FV (instead of cost less impairment model)

current_guidance_asc326.model: Credit loss model for debt securities
current_guidance_asc326.measurement: Allowance for credit losses (expected credit losses over life)
current_guidance_asc326.recognition: Recognize in income when expected credit loss identified
current_guidance_asc326.exception: HTM securities: Allowance account. AFS securities: Write-down to FV if below amortized cost.

impairment.equity_securities: Impairment model eliminated for equity securities measured at FV. For equity without readily determinable FV, qualitative impairment indicators assessed.

transfers_between_categories.general_rule: Transfers accounted for at fair value on transfer date
transfers_between_categories.htm_to_afs: Transfer at FV, recognize unrealized gain/loss in OCI
transfers_between_categories.afs_to_htm: Transfer at FV, keep accumulated OCI and amortize over remaining life
transfers_between_categories.to_trading: Transfer at FV, recognize unrealized gain/loss in income
transfers_between_categories.restriction: Frequent transfers out of HTM call into question intent/ability to hold to maturity

cpa_exam_strategies.classification: Key words: 'intent to hold to maturity' = HTM, 'short-term profit' = Trading, otherwise = AFS
cpa_exam_strategies.unrealized_gl: AFS = OCI (balance sheet equity). Trading = Net income. HTM = Not recognized.
cpa_exam_strategies.equity_method: Record % of investee's INCOME (not dividends). Dividends reduce investment balance.
cpa_exam_strategies.calculations: HTM: Amortize discount/premium. AFS: Adjust to FV with OCI. Trading: Adjust to FV with income.

key_points: Debt securities: HTM (amortized cost), AFS (FV with OCI), Trading (FV with income)
Equity <20%: FV through income. 20-50%: Equity method. >50%: Consolidate
Equity method: Record share of income, dividends reduce investment
AFS unrealized gains/losses in OCI, Trading unrealized gains/losses in income
HTM requires intent and ability to hold to maturity - no unrealized G/L recognized
